integrity: Proof reconstructed from weighted Cayley extension and Prüfer representation; direct finite rational enumeration independently corroborates identities. Inaccessible literature is flagged rather than assumed absent.
scientific_limitations: An exact first mixed moment, not a full joint law; finite enumeration through eight vertices supplements an all-n proof; the asymptotic invokes the known Wiener mean. Absolute literature priority and independent replication are unverified.
title: Exact negative Zagreb–Wiener covariance in uniform Cayley trees
